resources.string: If you allow it, Cyra reads four kinds of data from Health Connect: resting heart rate, heart rate variability, sleep sessions (including sleep stages) and skin temperature changes. Cyra only asks for skin temperature where Health Connect on this phone supports it. Cyra only reads. It never writes, changes or deletes anything in Health Connect.

To show patterns in your own data next to what you log. For example: a temperature rise consistent with ovulation having already happened (this confirms it after the fact and is not contraception), nights that look like night sweats, or changes in your resting heart rate.

Cyra reads this data on this phone and keeps it in Cyra\'s private storage on this phone. Cyra never sends it to Cyra\'s servers or to anyone else, and Cyra excludes its data from Android cloud backup and from phone-to-phone transfer. It only leaves this phone if you export an encrypted backup yourself, locked with a passphrase only you know.

You can remove Cyra\'s access at any time in Health Connect settings, and Cyra stops reading. To erase what Cyra saved on this phone, tap ⚙ in Cyra, then under Your data tap Delete everything and confirm, or uninstall Cyra. Encrypted backups you exported yourself are not affected; delete those where you saved them.
